description: Generated by web/scripts/contract-manifest.mjs; never edited by hand. A $ref resolves against this document: #/definitions/<Name>.

ledgerAccount.description: What `Transaction.account` carries for this account's movements.

amount.description: The balance of an account, the open bill of a card.

idle.description: True when the bank has sent nothing for the account in a while.

AccountRow.description: One account as the list shows it. A card shows its open bill where an account shows its balance.

ApiErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every failed call: `{"error":{"kind":"read_only"}}`.

ApprovalRequest.description: A change the model proposed that waits for a yes or a no.

Bucket.description: Where a pot's money counts in the net worth; a pot with none counts nowhere.

BudgetCell.description: One value of a row, already worked out; the screen only writes it.

BudgetDoc.description: The budget of a month: what is edited, saved and sent back to be evaluated.

BudgetEstablishment.description: What one establishment adds to a line in a month.

subtotalSpent.description: What the group's lines spent, for a group whose subtotal is a cap to compare it with.

over.description: The spending went past the cap.

flag.description: A marker the line carries, such as "Não garantida".

BudgetLineDoc.description: One line of the budget as it is stored and edited.

expandable.description: The line can be opened into the establishments that make it up.

BudgetLineView.description: `over` is a line past its cap, or a budget past its income. `bar` is the share of the amount reached, 0 to 100, for a row that draws one.

investmentRate.description: Planned investment, as a percent of the income. Negative when the budget outgrows the income.

correctionPercent.description: Null for a band no classification has fallen in.

CalibrationBand.description: How often the user corrected the model among classifications whose confidence fell in a band.

month.description: The month the bill fell due in.

day.description: Null for a line that sums up several purchases.

bankDay.description: The day the bank's own rule closes the bill on; null when the ledger holds no card.

manualDay.description: The day used when the mode is manual.

bestPurchaseDay.description: The first day whose purchases land on the bill after the open one.

payAhead.description: What the purchases since the closing add up to; zero before the month's closing day.

mayFallOnNextBill.description: Purchases of the two days before the closing, which the bank may still post to either bill.

name.description: The nickname when the establishment has one.

amount.description: Signed, as the transaction carries it.

CardPurchase.description: A card purchase listed under the pay-ahead figure or the ones that may still move.

suggestedThreshold.description: Null while no band has classifications to judge it by.

ChangeResult.description: What every write answers with: the handle that takes it back.

Classifier.description: Who put the transaction on its budget line.

markable.description: The person can mark it as done: steps 2 to 7 of a month that is still open.

ClosingStepState.description: `pending` is a step that blocks the close; `todo` one that is simply not done yet.

leftover.description: Variable cap minus what the variable lines spent; negative when they went over.

CounterpartyDetail.description: The establishment, or the person, behind a transaction.

lastBackup.description: Null when no backup has run.

EditableGroupKey.description: The groups of the budget a person edits; the others on the screen are derived from them.

reason.description: The user's answer to "why", when the step corrected the model.

undoable.description: True when taking this step back restores a previous state.

HistoryEntry.description: One step of a transaction's history, newest first in the detail.

payAhead.description: Present near the end of the month, when card purchases already fall on the next bill.

rate.description: Percent of the income; null when the budget has none.

planned.description: Percent of the income the budget plans to invest; null when the budget has no income.

actual.description: Percent of the income actually invested so far; null when the budget has no income.

IsoDay.description: A calendar day as `YYYY-MM-DD`, in Brazil time.

establishment.description: What "all purchases here" would apply to; null for a person or a movement, where it makes no sense.

progress.description: Percent of the plan done, capped at 100.

cap.description: Sum of the caps of the variable lines.

spent.description: What was spent on those lines.

name.description: Null for a pot nobody named.

detail.description: The bank, or "conta" for a bank account.

NetWorthItem.description: One thing that makes up a bucket: an account or a pot.

max.description: The value the top of the chart stands for.

months.description: The months the chart has room for, oldest first.

points.description: Only the months that have been recorded.

yields.description: `total` is null when no pot has a known yield.

NetWorthPoint.description: The net worth recorded at the end of one month.

PanelSections.description: Which sections of the panel apply to this kind of transaction.

markedByHand.description: Marked by the person, not found by the app.

cushion.description: Fixed and essential lines plus the variable ones: what the account must hold before the salary is set aside.

balance.description: Null when no account receives the salary.

difference.description: Balance minus cushion; null with no balance.

name.description: What the toast calls it: the nickname given now, else the establishment's name.

line.description: The line to put the transaction on: the suggestion, or the one picked instead.

always.description: Ties the establishment to the line for the purchases to come. Ignored for a person.

nickname.description: Only a person can be given one; ignored for an establishment.

PendingAnswer.description: What the person decided about one pending review.

PendingReview.description: A classification the app would not apply by itself, waiting for a decision.

difference.description: Signed so that negative is the bad direction: overspending, or income that fell short.

contributions.description: Provisions and reserves compare with what was set aside, not with what was spent.

difference.description: Signed so that negative is the bad direction: overspending, or income that fell short.

PotContribution.description: Where the month's planned deposit into the pot stands. `switched-off` is a pot that already reached its target, which turns the deposit off.

PotLinkedLine.description: A budget line the pot feeds; `share` is its part of the balance when several lines share the pot.

progress.description: Percent of the target reached, capped at 100.

amount.description: Null when the pot's rate is not known.

due.description: The next expected day has arrived.

RecurringPurchase.description: A purchase that repeats without being a subscription.

ReimbursementCandidate.description: A received PIX that could pay a purchase back.

expected.description: What the user expects to get back; half of the purchase until told otherwise.

proposalId.description: The change this paragraph suggests, when it suggests one.

sent.description: The suggested change is already waiting for approval.

resolved.description: Reviews answered through the queue so far, so the counter reads "3 de 8" while the queue shrinks.

name.description: The nickname when there is one.

person.description: The other side is a person: it can be given a nickname, and a rule for it makes no sense.

ReviewQueueItem.description: One transaction the model would not classify by itself, as the queue shows it.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription the warning is about; null opens the list.

belowTarget.description: Present only while the pot has a target and sits under it.

historyStart.description: The first month the ledger has data for; nothing earlier can appear.

cdiPercent.description: Null when the bank does not say what the pot pays.

monthlyYield.description: What the pot earned this month; zero for a closed pot, null when its rate is not known.

SavingsPotRow.description: One pot as the list shows it. A pot nobody named arrives with a null name.

changed.description: Per group and per line of the scenario: whether its amount is not the current budget's.

ScenarioImpact.description: A scenario weighed against the budget of the month.

name.description: The name it was kept under; a scenario without a name gets one.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Zero unless too many wrong PINs put the keypad on hold.

rawText.description: The bank's text without the PIX prefix.

cardTitle.description: Null when the ledger holds no card.

cdiPercent.description: Null when the bank does not say what the pot pays.

SubscriptionCandidate.description: A card purchase a subscription can be created from.

foreign.description: Present for a charge made in a foreign currency.

alternatives.description: Sentences the model wrote about cheaper plans; empty when it found none.

SubscriptionGroup.description: A status heading with its count and monthly total, or the whole list when it is not grouped.

monthlyEquivalent.description: The amount spread over the months of its cycle, to the cent.

reviewOverdue.description: The review date has arrived or passed.

SubscriptionRow.description: One subscription as the list shows it; every figure arrives computed.

SubscriptionSuggestion.description: A card purchase the app believes repeats like a subscription and asks to confirm.

name.description: The name to show: the nickname when the establishment or person has one.

originalName.description: The name before any nickname, kept so a search still finds it.

establishmentKey.description: Groups every transaction of one establishment or one person.

subtype.description: The bank's own type for what is neither card, PIX nor boleto.

effectiveAmount.description: What it counts for once a linked reimbursement is taken off.

countsInTotals.description: False for a movement between own accounts and for one marked as not counting.

classifiedBy.description: Null while nobody has put the transaction on a line.

confidence.description: Set when the classifier was the model.

belowThreshold.description: True when the model's confidence is under the configured threshold.

posted.description: False while the bank still reports the charge as pending.

tags.description: The transaction's own tags followed by the establishment's fixed ones, without repeats.

person.description: The other side is a person, not an establishment.

reimbursementIncome.description: A credit that pays back a purchase.

originalAmount.description: The amount in the currency of a foreign purchase, as text.

iof.description: The tax the bank charged on a foreign purchase, already inside `amount`.

name.description: The name to show: the nickname when the establishment or person has one.

originalName.description: The name before any nickname, kept so a search still finds it.

establishmentKey.description: Groups every transaction of one establishment or one person.

subtype.description: The bank's own type for what is neither card, PIX nor boleto.

effectiveAmount.description: What it counts for once a linked reimbursement is taken off.

countsInTotals.description: False for a movement between own accounts and for one marked as not counting.

classifiedBy.description: Null while nobody has put the transaction on a line.

confidence.description: Set when the classifier was the model.

belowThreshold.description: True when the model's confidence is under the configured threshold.

posted.description: False while the bank still reports the charge as pending.

tags.description: The transaction's own tags followed by the establishment's fixed ones, without repeats.

person.description: The other side is a person, not an establishment.

reimbursementIncome.description: A credit that pays back a purchase.

originalAmount.description: The amount in the currency of a foreign purchase, as text.

iof.description: The tax the bank charged on a foreign purchase, already inside `amount`.

accountDescription.description: The account as the panel's subtitle and details name it; a card carries its last digits.

justification.description: Why the model chose the line, for a pending review or a classification of its own.

askReason.description: True right after the user corrected the model, when the panel asks why.

ownTags.description: The transaction's own tags, not the establishment's fixed ones.

suggestedTags.description: Known tags the transaction does not have yet.

splitParts.description: Null while the purchase is not split.

splitRemaining.description: What the split still lacks (positive) or exceeds (negative); zero when it closes with the total.

reimbursement.description: Null while the purchase is not marked reimbursable.

exclusion.description: Null while "não conta" is off; a switch that is on with an empty reason does not count yet.

TransactionDetail.description: Everything the transaction panel shows, derived on the server.

lines.description: In the order a menu lists them: where spending goes first, income last.

spent.description: Null for a week that has not started.

remaining.description: Cap minus spent; negative once the cap is passed.

fill.description: How much of the cap is used, 0 to 100.

week.description: Null when the month has no current week.

WireErrorKind.description: The kinds a server can answer with: `network` means no answer arrived.
